   "source": [
    "(Tutorial_Get_ionic_interactions)=\n",
    "# get_ionic_interactions\n",
    "*Detecting minimum-distance observations between formal-charge centers.*\n",
    "\n",
    "Use selected-state chemical participants and an explicit distance cutoff to\n",
    "calculate a sparse analysis. This experimental method reports geometric\n",
    "proximity, not an electrostatic energy or a declared bond.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "See {func}`molsysmt.interactions.ionic.get_ionic_interactions` for the argument,\n",
    "error, and result contracts.\n",
    ":::"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c5dc6941",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "Let's show how this function works with explicit formal-charge participants.\n",
    "First inspect a bundled molecular system: coordinates and residue names alone\n",
    "do not provide the state chemistry required by this method."
   ]
  },
  {

   "id": "ce3fe030",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Construct a small analytical ensemble containing sodium, chloride, and\n",
    "potassium. The connectivity assumption is explicit: these isolated ions have\n",
    "no covalent bonds. The 0.4 nm cutoff is chosen for this example, not supplied as\n",
    "a universal scientific default."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "c07f14f4",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:12:41.232805Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-06T17:12:41.232523Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-06T17:12:41.285838Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-06T17:12:41.284717Z"
    },
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "3\n",
      "[0.3 0.3 0.2]\n",
      "{'distance': 'nm', 'positive_charge': 'e', 'negative_charge': 'e'}\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "from molsysmt import pyunitwizard as puw\n",
    "from molsysmt.native import MolSys, Topology\n",
    "\n",
    "molsys = MolSys()\n",
    "molsys.topology = Topology(n_atoms=3)\n",
    "molsys.topology.atoms['atom_type'] = ['Na', 'Cl', 'K']\n",
    "msm.set(molsys, element='atom', formal_charge=[1, -1, 1])\n",
    "coordinates = np.array([\n",
    "    [[0,0,0], [0.3,0,0], [0.6,0,0]],\n",
    "    [[0,0,0], [2,0,0], [4,0,0]],\n",
    "    [[0,0,0], [0.2,0,0], [0.8,0,0]],\n",
    "])\n",
    "molsys.structures.append(coordinates=puw.quantity(coordinates, 'nm'))\n",
    "\n",
    "analysis = msm.interactions.ionic.get_ionic_interactions(\n",
    "    molsys, '0.4 nm', pbc=False, assume_complete_connectivity=True)\n",
    "print(analysis.n_interactions)\n",
    "print(analysis.measurements['distance'])\n",
    "print(analysis.measure_units)\n",
    "assert analysis.n_interactions == 3\n",
    "assert not molsys.interactions"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "7d993d47",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Choosing structures\n",
    "\n",
    "Repeated structure indices are evaluated once in sorted order. A frame with\n",
    "no occurrences remains evaluated; an omitted frame remains unevaluated.\n",
    "All occurrence and participant indices address the original input system."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "a4f31290",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:12:41.289534Z",

   "outputs": [

     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[0, 2]\n",
      "[1]\n",
      "[]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "selected = msm.interactions.ionic.get_ionic_interactions(\n",
    "    molsys, '0.4 nm', structure_indices=[2, 0, 2], pbc=False,\n",
    "    assume_complete_connectivity=True)\n",
    "print(selected.evaluated_structure_indices.tolist())\n",
    "empty = analysis.query(structure_indices=[1]).to_dict()\n",
    "print(empty['evaluated_structure_indices'].tolist())\n",
    "print(empty['occurrence_indices'].tolist())\n",
    "assert selected.evaluated_structure_indices.tolist() == [0, 2]\n",
    "assert empty['evaluated_structure_indices'].tolist() == [1]"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5e883f25",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Choosing calculation scope\n",
    "\n",
    "`internal` searches only complete centers in the first selection. `incident`\n",
    "searches interactions involving those centers with any eligible center in the\n",
    "system, including internal contacts. `between` requires two disjoint selections.\n",
    "The detector rejects selections that cut a nonzero compound center."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "a9c3a702",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:12:41.307793Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-06T17:12:41.307615Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-06T17:12:41.341165Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-06T17:12:41.339914Z"
    },
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "2 3 3\n",
      "1\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "def calculate(**kwargs):\n",
    "    return msm.interactions.ionic.get_ionic_interactions(\n",
    "        molsys, '0.4 nm', pbc=False, assume_complete_connectivity=True, **kwargs)\n",
    "\n",
    "internal = calculate(selection=[0, 1], selection_mode='internal')\n",
    "incident = calculate(selection=[1], selection_mode='incident')\n",
    "between = calculate(selection=[0, 2], selection_2=[1], selection_mode='between')\n",
    "print(internal.n_interactions, incident.n_interactions, between.n_interactions)\n",
    "assert (internal.n_interactions, incident.n_interactions, between.n_interactions) == (2, 3, 3)\n",
    "print(analysis.query(structure_indices=[2], atom_indices=[0]).n_interactions)"
   ]
  },
  {

   "id": "f1088fbf",
   "metadata": {},

   "source": [
    "## Measuring compound participants\n",
    "\n",
    "Guanidinium and carboxylate illustrate charged groups found in arginine and\n",
    "acidic residues. Here you use explicit small-molecule chemistry as an analogue,\n",
    "with constructed coordinates rather than an experimental protein structure.\n",
    "This optional preparation uses RDKit through the existing conversion route.\n",
    "\n",
    "The positive participant includes the central carbon and three nitrogens;\n",
    "the negative one includes its carbon and two oxygens. Minimum distances use\n",
    "nitrogens and oxygens, respectively. Several close reference pairs still produce\n",
    "one occurrence per center pair."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",

   "id": "c7275dd6",

      "[0.2]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [

   ]

   "source": [
    "## Choosing a chemical state\n",
    "\n",
    "Recognition uses one state throughout the requested structures. Changing the\n",
    "formal charges changes the chemical participants without changing coordinates.\n",
    "The new state below declares all three isolated-ion sites neutral solely as an\n",
    "analytical control. It is not an inferred physical transformation."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "cc0cf184",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:12:42.469129Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-06T17:12:42.468949Z",

    },
    "tags": []

   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "0 1\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "neutral_index = molsys.chemical_states.append_state()\n",
    "msm.set(molsys, element='atom', chemical_state=neutral_index, formal_charge=[0, 0, 0])\n",
    "neutral = calculate(chemical_state=neutral_index)\n",
    "print(neutral.n_interactions, neutral.parameters['chemical_state_index'])\n",
    "assert neutral.n_interactions == 0\n",
    "assert calculate(chemical_state=0).n_interactions == 3"
   ]
  },

   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Applying periodic images\n",
    "\n",
    "When a box is present, the method uses MIC geometry. Add the reported lattice\n",
    "vector multiplied by the row-vector box to every atom of the corresponding\n",
    "participant. The positive participant is the reference image.\n",
    "\n",
    "Compound participants must already be whole in the source coordinates under\n",
    "the documented anchor-relative MIC condition. Split groups raise an explicit\n",
    "error: reconstructing them silently would make their saved image ambiguous."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "84673c06",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:12:42.498090Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-06T17:12:42.497913Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-06T17:12:42.547571Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-06T17:12:42.546520Z"
    },
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[[0, 0, 0], [-1, 0, 0]]\n",
      "[0.2]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "molsys_B = MolSys()\n",
    "molsys_B.topology = Topology(n_atoms=2)\n",
    "molsys_B.topology.atoms['atom_type'] = ['Na', 'Cl']\n",
    "msm.set(molsys_B, element='atom', formal_charge=[1, -1])\n",
    "xyz = np.array([[[0.1, 0, 0], [0.9, 0, 0]]])\n",
    "box = np.eye(3)[None]\n",
    "molsys_B.structures.append(coordinates=puw.quantity(xyz, 'nm'), box=puw.quantity(box, 'nm'))\n",
    "periodic = msm.interactions.ionic.get_ionic_interactions(\n",
    "    molsys_B, '0.4 nm', assume_complete_connectivity=True)\n",
    "displayed = xyz[0] + periodic.image_vectors @ box[0]\n",
    "print(periodic.image_vectors.tolist())\n",
    "print(periodic.measurements['distance'])\n",
    "assert np.isclose(np.linalg.norm(displayed[1] - displayed[0]), 0.2)"
   ]
  },

    "result explicitly under a name; the detector leaves existing analyses intact."

   "source": [
    "dictionary = calculate(output_type='molsysmt.InteractionsDict')\n",
    "restored = msm.convert(dictionary, to_form='molsysmt.Interactions')\n",
    "molsys.interactions = {**molsys.interactions, 'ionic': analysis}\n",
    "print(list(molsys.interactions))\n",
    "print(restored.software)\n",
    "assert restored.n_interactions == analysis.n_interactions"

   "source": [
    "## Calculating in blocks\n",
    "\n",
    "`heavy_mode='auto'` chooses coordinate blocks when the source or selected-buffer\n",
    "working estimate requires them. `force` requests blocks; `off` requests eager\n",
    "execution within the budget. Chunked input supports native `MolSys` and H5MSM\n",
    "0.5 paths with atom-index selections or `'all'`. Rich string selections use\n",
    "the eager route and are rejected for forced chunking.\n",
    "\n",
    "The following small example limits blocks to two structures. Scientific\n",
    "observations and occurrence indices agree with the eager analysis. Execution\n",
    "parameters record the path and actual number of blocks.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "b0c3b4eb",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:12:42.572951Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-06T17:12:42.572774Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-06T17:12:42.600102Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-06T17:12:42.599006Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "chunked 2\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "with msm.configure.context(chunk_size=2):\n",
    "    chunked = calculate(heavy_mode='force')\n",
    "    eager = calculate(heavy_mode='off')\n",
    "np.testing.assert_array_equal(chunked.occurrence_structures, eager.occurrence_structures)\n",
    "np.testing.assert_allclose(chunked.measurements['distance'], eager.measurements['distance'])\n",
    "print(chunked.execution_records[0]['details']['execution'], chunked.execution_records[0]['details']['execution_chunks'])\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e1242183",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Validation scope\n",
    "\n",
    "The bounded method has independent controls using the bundled Trp-cage (38 models) and villin HP35 coordinates with explicitly declared formal-charge states. Whole centers and their minimum distances are checked independently; the tests also cover empty frames, atom/frame selections, periodic image reconstruction, and H5MSM persistence. These controls validate the stated geometric rule for those states, not experimental protonation, interaction energies, or universal chemical recognition. The API remains experimental.\n",
    "\n",
    "## Understanding limits\n",
    "\n",
    "The recognizer uses formal charges, bounded carboxyl/guanidine rules and\n",
    "directly connected charged atoms. Atomic or generic cluster labels do not\n",
    "resolve phosphate, sulfate or aromatic delocalization universally. Their\n",
    "expansion is tracked by [MolSysMT #262](https://github.com/uibcdf/molsysmt/issues/262).\n",
    "Intramolecular contacts are included; directly covalently linked centers are\n",
    "excluded. Dative bonds do not impose that exclusion. Only one minimum-image\n",
    "observation is returned per center pair, not every possible periodic image.\n",
    "\n",
    "The calculation prepares chemistry once. For an H5MSM 0.5 input with index\n",
    "selections, it loads topology, chemical states and association metadata while\n",
    "reading only selected coordinate blocks and no saved analyses. These domains\n",
    "must declare identity atom-axis links. A structure-assigned state must be the\n",
    "same for all requested frames.\n",
    "\n",
    "The complete sparse analysis remains in memory. Numerical working estimates\n",
    "allocate one quarter of `max_ram_usage` to coordinate blocks, one eighth per\n",
    "candidate search and one half to sparse accumulation/packing. A calculation\n",
    "fails clearly when these estimates cannot fit; it does not return partial\n",
    "coverage or silently switch methods. These estimates do not bound process RSS:\n",
    "source coordinates, chemistry tables, Python objects and library overhead also\n",
    "occupy RAM. Conservative candidate bounds can reject a small budget even when\n",
    "actual neighbors would be sparse. No incremental result writer is provided.\n",
    "\n",
    "The cutoff includes a one-float64-ULP allowance for unit-conversion roundoff.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{seealso} Related Tools & References\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "- {func}`molsysmt.basic.convert` — preparing supported forms and serializing results.\n",
    "- {func}`molsysmt.physchem.get_charge_centers` — inspecting chemical participants.\n",
    "- {ref}`Cookbook_Saving_ionic_interactions` — saving a named analysis with its system.\n",
    ":::"
   ]
  }
